recap.text: Chris Andrews 2 is a level six human with a metal skullcap and one bronze star. He twists fist-sized butterfly bolts at Meadow Lark and uses an ethereal magic spear for five minutes. After noting that Agatha was edited out of a recap, he helps Imani pull residents through a safe room door. He tells the group that Jack had a weird-looking dick.

Chris picks a rock race called an igneous, which makes him strong and changes his personality. He fights with Brandon and leaves with several men, but only Chris survives. Chris kills Frank Q at the Desperado Club and is banned from the club. Carl reads Brandon's last message about his brother.

A man claiming to be Chris Andrews arrives at level 35 as a Zulu Warrior. Crawler Carl identifies him as a Scree parasite named Maggie My. Crawler Donut drops them into a sealed chamber. Crawler Carl uses a phase potion to pull the worm from Chris's head, and Mongo kills it. Chris joins the Royal Court's party and walks into the stairwell.

A dark, rocky leg crushes a weasel pet crawling toward the paralyzed Carl. Chris picks Carl up, burning his skin, and carries him into the personal space over his shoulder. Chris and Clay-ton trade one grunt each, and Clay-ton is assigned to stay with Chris.

Imani hugs Chris with her wings. Carl glimpses Imani's mind and sees she loves Chris for his simplicity and quiet kindness. Chris and his bodyguard, Clay-ton, sit side by side and grunt at one another.

Chris drives a semitruck with a trailer alone after talking both Erins into leaving. He wears Meadow Lark work overalls and has been turned from an igneous into a werewolf. After telling Imani he loves her, Chris drops away at a portal. In Sheol, a bald Crest knocks him unconscious with a bolt because a werewolf about to turn kills everyone near it.

beats.headline: The quiet brother
beats.text: For the record: Chris Andrews 2, level six, human, one bronze star. Taller and less stocky than his brother Brandon, a metal skullcap, no visible weapon. The brother's briefing on him, delivered while Chris looks on impassively: not exactly mute, but he don't say too much. Their mother thought he was slow and put him in a special school because he never spoke. He is not dumb. Think of him as Silent Bob. If he says something, you better listen.
beats.gist: Chris Andrews 2 is a level six human with one bronze star and a metal skullcap.

beats.headline: I liked that show
beats.text: The Andrews brothers are the maintenance men at Meadow Lark, on overtime that night fixing an oven, and they know tools. Chris twists the fist-sized butterfly bolts that hold the redoubt together. While they practise, Crawler Donut compares the build to The A-Team, or MacGyver, and Chris says, "I liked that show." First words on the record. He does not say which show. In the fight with the swine he twirls an ethereal magic spear, a spell of his that lasts five minutes.
beats.gist: Chris Andrews is a Meadow Lark maintenance man who twists fist-sized butterfly bolts and twirls spears.

beats.headline: Agatha, edited out
beats.text: After the tuskling fight he dropped to his knees and hung his head. Now he sits in a corner of the safe room, head low, possibly crying. His brother reports that his boss box gave him "some book of the club thing." Then the recap airs the redoubt without Agatha's picture, and Chris speaks for the second time on the record: she was next to him under the speedbump, and she was not there when they showed it. She was edited out.
beats.gist: Chris sits in a safe room corner and says Agatha was edited out of the recap.

beats.headline: He really did
beats.text: The people train runs on one glowing chain, three hundred feet of it, from Chris through ten cars of residents and back to Imani, and once it gets going he barely feels the weight. When the rage elemental forms, he and Imani pull residents out of their chairs and throw them through the safe room door. The recap replays Jack, and then Yolanda. Afterwards, nobody speaks until Chris does: "He really did have a weird-looking dick." Imani wraps her arms around him, laughing and crying at once.
beats.gist: Chris and Imani throw residents through a safe room door to escape a rage elemental.

beats.headline: Igneous, and changed
beats.text: For the record, by Imani's account: Chris picked a rock race called an igneous. Lava rock, covered in little holes. He got very strong, and it changed his personality. After a couple of days he and Brandon were fighting constantly. Chris wanted to hunt and kill every minute of every day and go find Crawler Carl, whom he respected as aggressive; Brandon wanted to train close to the stairwell. Several men left with Chris. Of those who broke away, only he is alive, and he answers nobody.
beats.gist: Chris picks an igneous lava rock and becomes strong and aggressive.

beats.headline: Frank Q, at the bar
beats.text: Frank Q is dead, and the Sledge reports who did it. A crawler sat with Frank at the Desperado Club, they got into a fight, and the crawler killed him and walked right out. That crawler is now banned from the club. It was Chris, a rock monster like the Sledge but a different kind. Crawler Carl does not recognise the quiet man he knew in this, and reads Brandon's last message about his brother again and again.
beats.gist: Chris killed Frank Q at the Desperado Club and is now banned from the club.

beats.headline: The man inside is not Chris
beats.text: He walks up at level 35, Igneous, Zulu Warrior, having taken the bridge of the Akula and been fired out of a missile tube. He claims chat costs him health. He says his family is dead, and that he has two daughters. Crawler Carl works it out: this is Maggie My. A petrify bolt drops him. Mordecai names the parasite: a Scree, an infiltrator, and the host is awake behind his own eyes. Through Elle comes a message from Chris himself: "Carl, Donut. Please. Kill me."
beats.gist: Chris Andrews appears as a level 35 Zulu Warrior who was fired out of a missile tube.

beats.headline: Dropped through the street
beats.text: A second message arrives through Elle before his privileges are suspended: Maggie worships Algos, the god of pain, and she and he share two sponsors, Prince Maestro and Crown Prince Stalwart. Crawler Carl puts a hand on his rocky shoulder and tells him that his brother loved him and regretted never saying so. Brandon gave his life protecting his friends. Then Crawler Donut opens a hole beneath him, and host and worm fall into a sealed chamber below the street. She is not letting Crawler Carl kill a friend.
beats.gist: Chris receives a message through Elle that Maggie worships Algos and shares sponsors with him.

beats.headline: Enslaved, and muted
beats.text: The group quest list shows two names at the bottom, separated: Maggie My, and Chris Andrews 2, Enslaved. The enslaved can still chat. While Crawler Donut shouts at Maggie, Chris types, "Donut. Please." They are out of the chamber, he reports: down a ladder, a wire in the water disconnected, a group of crawlers attacked and one of them killed. Then: "Maggie is cheating. She has outside help. A cap…" Chris has been muted from chat, and his previous notes disappear from the log.
beats.gist: The group quest list shows Chris Andrews 2 as Enslaved.

beats.headline: Pulled out through a phase potion
beats.text: Maggie, hidden in the sand, says they have her other daughter. Chris erupts beside the winding box and hurls it. Crawler Carl, phased through lava rock by a potion, reaches into his head and pulls the worm out; it burrows into Carl instead, comes out through his neck, and Mongo ends it. Chris sits with a hand on his head. "That hurt." Then, in a daze: "Brandon. Brandon." He is added to the Royal Court's party, and walks into the stairwell without looking back.

beats.headline: A foot on the weasel
beats.text: First day of the sixth floor. A weasel pet crawls toward the paralysed Crawler Carl's face, and a dark, rocky leg crushes it. Chris picks Carl up, burning his skin, and carries him into the personal space over his shoulder. When the Royal Court receives four cretin mercenaries, Chris and Clay-ton, almost exactly the same size, trade one grunt each. Clay-ton is assigned to stay with Chris.
beats.gist: Chris crushes a weasel with a rocky leg, burns Carl's skin, and carries him.

beats.headline: What Imani carries
beats.text: For the file, by the most private route available. Imani gives Chris a quick hug with her wings, not her arms, and he reaches up as if to touch her face and stops just short. When Crawler Carl is bound for a moment to the minds around him, he catches a glimpse of Imani's: she is in love with Chris, and Carl had no idea. She loves his simplicity. His quiet kindness. Clay-ton, his bodyguard since the Hunting Grounds, has become his inseparable friend; the two sit side by side and grunt at one another.
beats.gist: Imani hugs Chris with her wings, and Carl sees that Imani loves Chris's simplicity.

beats.headline: I should have taken a deal
beats.text: Team Chris and the Erins, a semitruck with a trailer. Chris says it is big but slow. Imani: kinda like you. His rock face crinkles into something like a smile. Chris refuses a deal if Imani is staying; he talks both Erins into leaving and drives the rig alone. The final heat puts him in the same race as Imani and Elle. "It is okay. I should have taken a deal." Imani: "No, Chris. No."
beats.gist: Chris drives a big, slow semitruck with a trailer alone after talking both Erins into leaving.

beats.headline: The most important part
beats.text: He has been turned from an igneous into a werewolf, human most of the time, and stands in the same Meadow Lark work overalls he wore when Crawler Carl first met him. At the Desperado Club, Clay-ton puts down his bass and stands with them until the guards step aside. At the portal, Imani makes him promise to run if he sees the exit. "I love you," Chris says. "I always have. No matter what happens next, I love you. That's the most important part." He steps forward, turns, waves, and drops away.
beats.gist: Chris tells Imani he loves her before waving and dropping away at the portal.

beats.headline: Change imminent, in Sheol
beats.text: Crawler Louis wakes somewhere hot, and the notice does not say what the plan said. Entering Sheol. Chris is there, struggling, held down by strangers, a warning flashing over his head: Change imminent. A bald Crest fires a bolt and knocks him unconscious, because a werewolf about to turn kills everyone near it. Britney tells them who he is: Chris, changed by the first Scolopendra attack. Don't hurt him.
beats.gist: Crawler Louis enters Sheol and finds Chris. A bald Crest knocks Chris unconscious with a bolt.
